label: Can be without: unindexed accessible contrast or through another's power
term: being able to be without another (accessible contrast versus another's power)
resolution: DEF-CAN-BE-WITHOUT reads 'possunt esse sine' as real possibility without fixing whose possibility. In the counterfactual-dependence route (arguments 18a75892 and 0a971de7) the soundness, coverage and preservation premises (2bdb0be1, 06047f4c, 31bcb75e) speak only of the frame accessibility (definition 88302e83), and preservation's antecedent and realization 11dc5069's consequent are CAN_BE_WITHOUT_1 (beingWithoutHasAccessibleWitness_iff). The conclusion 000e1f65 keeps the undifferentiated relation of DEF-CAN-BE-WITHOUT as a parameter, and 11dc5069 is the only passage from it into sense 1; nothing passes back. Under the selector left free, the selection premises together are exactly 000e1f65 with being-without read in sense 1 (track_cover_iff_strict, track_preserve_iff_strict). The premises' warrant depends on one reading of the accessibility. If it is possibility in the order of the beings' natures and causes, 11dc5069 is plausible only when DEF-CAN-BE-WITHOUT is read the same way, and 000e1f65 is then a natural-order impossibility. If DEF-CAN-BE-WITHOUT is read in sense 2 (through another's power), 11dc5069 requires every contrast some power can bring about to be realized at an accessible world, and with that requirement the selection premises deny that any power can bring about the effect without its source. No relation between CAN_BE_WITHOUT_1 and CAN_BE_WITHOUT_2 is recorded in either direction, so no argument may pass between them. The in-subject versus another's-power split for 'possible not to be' (d25cee67) is a parallel fork, not identified with this one.
